style: Friendly 3D classroom vocabulary, transparent cutout, readable at 60 pixels

assets.prompt: A brown-haired boy in a blue shirt actively taps a large smartphone with an extended finger, screen visible. Fingers interacting, not merely holding.
A brown-haired boy in a blue shirt walking while carrying a large heavy school bag with both arms, body leaning under its weight.

A brown-haired boy in a blue shirt has just discovered a large shiny key under the edge of a cushion, lifting the cushion with one hand and reaching toward the visible key with the other, delighted surprised face.
An adult man hands a large coin to a shopkeeper's outstretched hand while receiving one vivid red apple. Focus on exchange, coin and apple, faces secondary.
Close-up of a boy's blue shirt torso and hands pushing a large open book shut, covers almost together, obvious closing motion and a simple curved movement swoosh, no text.

A smiling brown-haired boy already dressed in a vivid blue short-sleeved shirt, points with both index fingers at the shirt on his chest. Shirt dominates composition, fully dressed, no pulling fabric.
A fully clothed brown-haired boy puts a bright blue overshirt on OVER a white T-shirt, one arm visibly sliding into a sleeve, overshirt still open. Hands and sleeve prominent.

A fully clothed brown-haired boy removes a bright blue overshirt FROM OVER a white T-shirt. One arm pulls out of the sleeve, overshirt off one shoulder, white undershirt remains fully covering torso. Clear removal gesture.

An adult man wearing a bicycle helmet actively rides a vivid red bicycle, both hands steering handlebars, feet on pedals. Tight compact three-quarter composition with bike and rider fully recognizable.
An adult man raises his hand to hail a large approaching blue city bus, front of bus with windshield and door close beside him. The waving gesture and bus dominate, no lettering or numbers.
An adult man stepping up into the open doorway of a large blue bus, one foot on the step and one hand holding the rail. Doorway and boarding action dominate.
A boy in a blue shirt gently helps another fully clothed child stand up by extending his hand and pulling them up. Two figures, visible linked hands, cooperative supportive gesture.
A brown-haired boy in blue shirt attentively watches a small television showing a vivid red ball. Three-quarter side view, eyes clearly directed at the screen, no text.
A friendly adult woman shows a child an open book, points at a large apple picture on its page while the child attentively follows. Book and pointing teaching gesture dominate, no text.
A brown-haired boy in a blue shirt sits naturally on a simple chair, side three-quarter view, bent knees and hips clearly visible, feet on ground. Whole pose tightly fills square.
A brown-haired boy in a blue shirt stands upright on both straight legs, both feet visible planted on ground, arms relaxed, head to toe, compact silhouette.
A brown-haired boy in a blue shirt stands waiting, looks down at an oversized wristwatch on his raised wrist, other hand on hip, patient slightly bored expression. Watch and face large.

An adult man carrying a blue bag steps INTO a simple open doorway toward the viewer from outside. Happy greeting raised hand, front view, one foot crossing the doorstep. Doorframe tightly surrounds figure.
An adult man carrying a blue bag steps OUT through an open doorway, back three-quarter view moving away, one hand waving goodbye over his shoulder. Doorframe tightly surrounds figure.

Close-up of an adult man's blue shirt torso and hands wiping a tabletop with a bright yellow cloth, a clear clean shiny patch and two small sparkles beside the wiping hand. No bucket or unrelated props.
